messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Hydrochlorothiazide starts to work within 2 hours of a dose, with the peak effect at about 4 hours. The increase in urine output lasts for around 6 to 12 hours, while the medicine's overall action on the body can persist for up to 24 hours.
Lowering blood pressure takes longer than the fluid effect, and your doctor will usually reassess your blood pressure after a few weeks rather than straight away.
The medicine is well absorbed, is not broken down by the body, and is cleared by the kidneys, with most of a dose passing out unchanged in the urine. Its half-life, meaning the time for blood levels to fall by half, has been reported as 6 to 15 hours. In people with kidney disease, levels in the blood are higher and the medicine stays in the body longer.
Hydrochlorothiazide controls high blood pressure but does not cure it. Keep taking it even if you feel well, because high blood pressure often causes no symptoms.
Triples: [["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "starts to work", "2 hours after dose"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has peak effect", "4 hours after dose"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has urine output increase duration", "6 to 12 hours"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has overall body action duration", "up to 24 hours"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has delayed effect", "lowering of blood pressure"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "requires reassessment of", "blood pressure after few weeks"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has absorption property", "well absorbed"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "is not metabolized by body", "not broken down"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "is cleared by", "kidneys"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has elimination route", "urine"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has half life", "6 to 15 hours"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has increased blood levels in", "kidney disease"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has prolonged duration in", "kidney disease"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "treats", "high blood pressure"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "does not cure", "high blood pressure"], ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "has patient instruction", "keep taking even if feeling well"]]
Relations: ["does not cure", "has absorption property", "has delayed effect", "has elimination route", "has half life", "has increased blood levels in", "has overall body action duration", "has patient instruction", "has peak effect", "has prolonged duration in", "has urine output increase duration", "is cleared by", "is not metabolized by body", "requires reassessment of", "starts to work", "treats"]
Answer:

completion:
does not cure: The subject drug does not provide a permanent resolution or cure for the condition specified by the object entity.  
has absorption property: The subject drug is efficiently absorbed into the bloodstream when administered.  
has delayed effect: The subject drug produces a therapeutic effect on the specified condition after a delay compared to its initial action.  
has elimination route: The subject drug is primarily excreted from the body via the specified route.  
has half life: The subject drug has a half-life duration specified by the object entity, indicating the time it takes for blood levels to reduce by half.  
has increased blood levels in: In individuals with the specified condition, the blood levels of the subject drug are higher than normal.  
has overall body action duration: The subject drug's overall physiological effect on the body lasts for the duration specified by the object entity.  
has patient instruction: Patients taking the subject drug are advised to follow the specified instruction to ensure effective treatment.  
has peak effect: The subject drug reaches its maximum therapeutic effect at the time specified by the object entity.  
has prolonged duration in: In individuals with the specified condition, the duration of the subject drug's presence in the body is extended.  
has urine output increase duration: The increase in urine output caused by the subject drug lasts for the duration specified by the object entity.  
is cleared by: The subject drug is removed from the body primarily through the specified organ or system.  
is not metabolized by body: The subject drug is not broken down or chemically transformed by the body's metabolic processes.  
requires reassessment of: The subject drug's effectiveness requires periodic evaluation of the specified condition after the time interval specified by the object entity.  
starts to work: The subject drug begins to exert its therapeutic effect within the time frame specified by the object entity.  
treats: The subject drug is used to manage or reduce the symptoms or progression of the condition specified by the object entity.
